title: Open-to-close price intervals
intent: Show real Apple daily open-to-close price intervals as horizontal ranged bars without converting observations into a proprietary series model.

ai.create: Create a responsive interval chart directly from AAPL Date, Open, and Close fields using one horizontal ranged bar per trading day and gain/loss colors.
ai.maintain: Change the selected trading window without changing the source data model, clipping date labels, or introducing casts.
